output.risk_rationale: Adyen N.V. (KvK 34259528, LEI 724500973ODKK3IFQ447) is an active Dutch public company with a European banking licence, supervised by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB), and listed on Euronext Amsterdam. Its registry details agree across GLEIF, a KvK mirror (liza.nl) and the UK Register of Overseas Entities. No sanctions matches came up for the entity or its main executives when checked through OpenSanctions, which covers the OFAC SDN, UK and EU lists. No beneficial owner holds a registrable stake; the UK overseas-entity register states that none has been identified, which fits a widely held listed company. No management or supervisory board member was identified as a PEP. Searches in English and Dutch found no fines, AML enforcement, fraud, corruption, sanctions-evasion or litigation findings against Adyen N.V. in the last 10 years. The only finding is a low-severity one: the UK overseas-entity annual statement is overdue and the officer list there is stale. I excluded three items. First, the Brazilian competition authority's (CADE) antitrust inquiry concerned the subsidiary Adyen do Brasil, not Adyen N.V., and it was closed and archived in March 2026 (MLex, 3 Mar 2026). Second, a US labour board (NLRB) charge against 'Adyen NV' (13-CA-365589) could not be verified because the page would not load; search snippets describe it as dismissed and closed in 2025. Third, an OpenSanctions 'close associate' hit in the Vogelzang search belonged to a different person. Leadership is changing: the CFO left on 31 Aug 2026, with an interim CFO in place and Niclas Neglen nominated from 1 Feb 2027; the Supervisory Board chair changed on 1 Nov 2026; and an update to the executive leadership model takes effect on 31 Jan 2027. None of these is a negative indicator. The main residual risk is that payment processing is a business with inherently higher money-laundering exposure. Overall rating: low. Gaps: I did not open the live KvK extract or GLEIF's own website (registration data comes from the GLEIF API and the liza.nl mirror). The branch LEIs and the Adyen do Brasil registry number were not confirmed on any page I opened. Nationalities for Tom Adams, Hwa Tsao, Niclas Neglen and the Supervisory Board members were not stated. I did not query the OFAC, OFSI or EU lists directly, only through OpenSanctions.
